# Storage of IadSm172.Route

Storage `SQLStorage`, type `%Storage.SQL`, editable with iris_storage_map.

| Keyword | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `StreamLocation` | `^IadSm172RouteS` |

- table is writable: master global starts with ^, $, or @

## Map `Master` (data, master map)

Global layout: `^IadSm172Route({Depot},{Seq})`

| Level | Expression | Access type | Delimiter | Other |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `{Depot}` | sub | — | access var 1 `{1D1}` = ` s {1D1}=$g(^IadSm172Route({L1}))` |
| 2 | `{Seq}` | Sub | — | stop_expression `{L2}\900`; invalid if `'{1D1}` |

| Field | Node | Delimiter | Piece | Format | Filed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Name` | row node | `"^"` | `1` | delimited | yes |
| `Stops` | row node | `"^"` | `2` | delimited | yes |

Facts:

- access variable {1D1}: the map sets it by code (not read from the global), and iad does not evaluate that code
- level 2 filters its keys by code (Invalidcondition): the map skips a key when the code is true, and iad does not evaluate it
